description: This file defines extension methods for setting up dependency injection for the infrastructure layer of a customer management project. It primarily registers database context, repositories, and related services with the DI container.

classes.name: DependencyInjection
classes.description: Static class containing extension method to add infrastructure services to the DI container.

methods.name: AddInfrastructure
methods.description: Extension method to register database context, repositories, and interfaces related to infrastructure layer into the DI container.
